It was established in 1980 and is headquartered in [[Gandhinagar]].{{cite web|url=http://www.moneycontrol.com/company-facts/gujgas/management/GGC|title=Company Facts – Gujarat Gas|publisher=CNBC TV18 Money Control|access-date=2011-10-07}} It is India's largest city gas distribution (CGD) company.{{cn|date=September 2025}} == History == Gujarat Gas Company Limited (GGCL) was incorporated in 1980, and is in the business of procurement and distribution of natural gas. The company went public in October 1991, listing on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and the [[National Stock Exchange (India)|National Stock Exchange]]. The [[BG Group]] acquired a majority stake in the company in 1997.{{cite web|url=http://www.gujaratgas.com/gujaratgas/website/content.aspx?pageid=179&parentid=1&pagelevel=1|title=GGCL History|publisher=Gujarat Gas Company Limited|access-date=2011-10-07|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111104020309/http://www.gujaratgas.com/gujaratgas/website/content.aspx?pageid=179&parentid=1&pagelevel=1|archive-date=4 November 2011|url-status=dead}} In October 2012, the majority owner in the firm, [[BG Group]], sold its 65% stake for a fee of around $470 million. The buyer was GSPC Gas, a unit of the state-run [[Gujarat State Petroleum Corporation]] (GSPC).{{cite news| url=http://uk.reuters.com/article/bg-brief-idUKL6E8L3DVL20121003| archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160306101337/http://uk.reuters.com/article/bg-brief-idUKL6E8L3DVL20121003| url-status=dead| archive-date=6 March 2016| title=BG offloads Gujarat Gas stake for $470 mln | work=Reuters| date=3 October 2012}} GSPC Gas and GGCL were merged in 2015 and the new company was named Gujarat Gas Limited.{{Cite news |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/ahmedabad/GSPC-Gas-GGCL-merger-completed/articleshow/47315374.cms |title=GSPC Gas, GGCL merger completed |newspaper=The Times of India |date=17 May 2015 }} == Operations == As of May 2015, Gujarat Gas Limited has City Gas Distribution (CGD) network in 649 human settlements (city, town, villages) in 19 [[List of districts of Gujarat|districts of Gujarat]] and [[Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli]] and [[Thane]] GA (including [[Palghar district]]) of [[Maharashtra]]. As of 2017, it has the largest customer base in gas distribution sector in India: 10,80,000 domestic households, 2,835 industrial customers, 11,900 commercial and non-commercial customers, 233 CNG stations selling more than 7,65,000 kg of CNG per day serving to more than 1,60,000 vehicles per day. It has achieved the highest total daily gas sales volume in India, up to 6.5 million cubic metre per day at [[Standard temperature and pressure|standard conditions]]. It market capitalisation was Rs. 10,600 crore (15 May 2015).{{Cite web|url=http://www.gujaratgas.com/about-us/from-ceos-desk/|title=From CEO's Desk {{!}} About Us|website=gujaratgas.com|access-date=2017-06-24}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Gujarat}} {{Nifty 200 companies}} {{Energy companies and organisations in India}} [[Category:Companies based in Ahmedabad]] [[Category:Oil and gas companies of India]] [[Category:Utilities of India]] [[Category:Energy in Gujarat]] [[Category:Non-renewable resource companies established in 1980]] [[Category:Natural gas companies of India]] [[Category:1980 establishments in Gujarat]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1980]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:1997 mergers and acquisitions]] [[Category:2012 mergers and acquisitions]] [[Category:Government-owned companies of Gujarat]] {{India-company-stub}}
